description: Get the signed-in member's lists with their items, private lists included. This is the same set as the Lists tab on their own profile, so it includes the system lists (Want to Play, Want to Own, Favorites and Following; each has is_system true and changes through the favorite, ownership and follow tools, not the list tools). Without listId, every list comes back with its first 10 items (items_truncated says when there are more). With listId, that one list comes back with every item and its body text. Each list and item carries its kineticist.com page url; each item has an item_id (use it to edit or remove the item) and its position in the list.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

name: kineticist_get_my_lists
title: Get your lists
